collection.description: A villager's private sunrise song is overheard by a child who could not sleep: sing it again, or keep it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Every morning, before anyone else is awake, (subject) sings one song very quietly to the sunrise. (subject.He/She) made it up as a child and has never sung it for anyone else. This morning (subject.he/she) finishes the last line and hears a small voice behind (subject.him/her): "Can you sing it again?" It's (child), (friend)'s child, who couldn't sleep.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (subject) sings it again, a little louder this time. (child) hums along. By the third time, (child) knows all the words. (subject) isn't sure how (subject.he/she) feels about sharing it. Then (child) says, "That's my favorite song now," and (subject) decides (subject.he/she) feels good about it.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: "That one's just for me," (subject) says gently. "But I know lots of others." (subject.He/She) sings a silly song about a fish who wanted to be a bird. (child) giggles all the way home. The morning song stays quiet and private, the way it's always been.
